summary: Defined workflow schema and persistence layer for visual editor state. Created TypeScript interfaces (Workflow, WorkflowNode, WorkflowConnection, and input types) in src/types/workflow.ts. Built WorkflowPersistenceService with async CRUD methods (createWorkflow, getWorkflowById, listWorkflows, updateWorkflow, deleteWorkflow) following existing TodoManager/persistence patterns using Neo4j driver. Added composite indexes on (workflowId, nodeType), (workflowId, sourceNodeId, targetNodeId), and userId in GraphManager.initialize() for query performance. Exported all new types and the service from the barrel files.
